source: owner-supplied kit script 001 (docs/storytelling-kit/03_SCRIPTS/001_every_lie_creates_a_monster.md); text unchanged, Plan A approved 2026-11-20
world_rule: Every lie creates a creature. Only the person being lied to can see it; the liar cannot. It grows with every lie. Telling the truth makes it disappear.
logline: A brother keeps lying to protect his little sister from their dad's absence, not knowing she can see the monster his lies create.

characters.name: Noah
characters.arc: false reassurance > denial > guilt > truth > connection
characters.look: render/kit.js KIT_CAST.noah: messy dark-brown hair, blue hoodie, dark jeans, white sneakers, peach skin, scale 1.0

characters.name: Lily
characters.want: for Dad to come; not to be sad alone
characters.look: render/kit.js KIT_CAST.lily: long brown hair, pink bow, pink sweater with heart, cream pants, scale 0.8

characters.name: Lie-Monster
characters.look: render/kit.js lieMonster: navy-black smoky block body, smoke spikes, round amber eyes; shoe > knee > waist > taller than Noah > dissolves

locations: birthday room (warm gold vs cold empty chair)

lines.text: In our town, the person you lie to is the only one who can see the monster.
lines.say: (nervous)(soft tone) In our town, (break) the person you lie to is the only one who can see the monster.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: And my little sister watched mine grow for three days.
lines.say: (worried)(soft tone) And my little sister watched mine grow (break) for three days.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Every lie creates a creature.
lines.say: (calm) Every lie creates a creature.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The liar can't see it. Only the person hearing the lie can.
lines.say: (calm) The liar can't see it. Only the person hearing the lie can.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: And there's only one way to make it disappear.
lines.say: (calm) And there's only one way (break) to make it disappear.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Tell the truth.
lines.say: (confident)(soft tone) Tell the truth.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.silent_beat: kitchen: phone insert 'I'm sorry. I can't make it this weekend.' Noah hides it; Lily enters with paper crown

lines.text: Do you think Dad will come early for my birthday?
lines.say: (happy)(soft tone) Do you think Dad will come early for my birthday?
lines.speaker: Lily

lines.text: Of course. He promised.
lines.say: (confident) Of course. (break) He promised.
lines.speaker: Noah
lines.silent_beat: tiny black creature crawls out from behind Noah's shoe; Lily notices, smile fades

lines.text: Noah... what's standing behind you?
lines.say: (scared)(whispering) Noah... (break) what's standing behind you?
lines.speaker: Lily

lines.text: Nothing. You're probably just tired. Go finish your crown.
lines.say: (relaxed) Nothing. You're probably just tired. Go finish your crown.
lines.speaker: Noah
lines.silent_beat: creature grows to knee height; Lily takes one step away

lines.text: Did Dad remember my favorite cake?
lines.say: (happy)(soft tone) Did Dad remember my favorite cake?
lines.speaker: Lily

lines.text: Of course. Chocolate, right?
lines.say: (nervous) Of course. Chocolate, right?
lines.speaker: Noah
lines.silent_beat: creature grows behind him at breakfast

lines.text: Do you think he'll like this?
lines.say: (happy)(soft tone) Do you think he'll like this?
lines.speaker: Lily

lines.text: He's going to love it.
lines.say: (nervous) He's going to love it.
lines.speaker: Noah
lines.silent_beat: Noah breaks eye contact; creature waist-high

lines.text: Will he really be here tomorrow?
lines.say: (worried)(soft tone) Will he really be here tomorrow?
lines.speaker: Lily

lines.text: Yes, Lily. I already told you.
lines.say: (frustrated) Yes, Lily. (soft tone) I already told you.
lines.speaker: Noah
lines.silent_beat: reveal: creature taller than Noah behind him at the night window; cut to birthday table, empty chair push-in

lines.text: Should we wait a little longer?
lines.say: (sad)(soft tone) Should we wait a little longer?
lines.speaker: Lily
lines.silent_beat: Noah opens his mouth but cannot answer

lines.text: Noah... I think it gets bigger every time you tell me he's coming.
lines.say: (sad)(soft tone) Noah... (break) I think it gets bigger every time you tell me he's coming.
lines.speaker: Lily

lines.text: That's when I realized...
lines.say: (worried) That's when I realized...
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She had seen every lie.
lines.say: (sad)(soft tone) She had seen every lie.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.silent_beat: close-up: Noah's fake smile disappears, eyes lower

lines.text: Dad isn't coming, Lily.
lines.say: (sad) Dad isn't coming, (break) Lily.
lines.speaker: Noah

lines.text: He messaged me yesterday.
lines.say: (sad) He messaged me yesterday.
lines.speaker: Noah

lines.text: I was scared you'd be heartbroken.
lines.say: (sad)(soft tone) I was scared you'd be heartbroken.
lines.speaker: Noah

lines.text: I thought if I kept saying yes, tomorrow wouldn't hurt.
lines.say: (sad)(soft tone) I thought if I kept saying yes, (break) tomorrow wouldn't hurt.
lines.speaker: Noah
lines.silent_beat: creature cracks, eyes dim, dissolves into particles (~4 s)

lines.text: I was already sad, Noah.
lines.say: (sad)(soft tone) I was already sad, (break) Noah.
lines.speaker: Lily

lines.text: I just didn't want to be sad alone.
lines.say: (sad)(soft tone) I just didn't want to be sad alone.
lines.speaker: Lily
lines.silent_beat: Lily wipes her eyes, takes Noah's hand, puts the paper crown on his head

lines.text: Can you stay for the dance?
lines.say: (happy)(soft tone) Can you stay for the dance?
lines.speaker: Lily

lines.text: Of course. And this time, I mean it.
lines.say: (empathetic) Of course. And this time, (break) I mean it.
lines.speaker: Noah
lines.silent_beat: they dance beside the cake; empty chair stays visible; monster gone

lines.text: Sometimes, the truth hurts for a moment.
lines.say: (moved)(soft tone) Sometimes, the truth hurts for a moment.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But a lie can make someone feel alone for much longer.
lines.say: (moved)(soft tone) But a lie can make someone feel alone (break) for much longer.
lines.speaker: narrator

upload.title: In This Town, Only The Person You Lie To Can See Your Monster #Shorts
upload.description:
Every lie he told his little sister made the monster bigger.
Would you have told her the truth sooner?
In a town where lies become monsters only the listener can see, a brother learns what his kind lies really cost.
Original animated story. Not affiliated with Roblox or any creator.
